name: 下班前上线

roles.name: 凌澈
roles.voice: young male, clean low-mid register, flat and even, deadpan, cold, short phrasing

roles.name: 砚舟
roles.voice: young male, clear warm mid register, chest-supported, slow and relaxed pace

look: 半写实插画风格，细腻笔触与柔和光影，安静的都市深夜与清晨质感。
setting: 一间办公室：靠窗的工位上摆着一张桌子，桌上一台亮着的电脑显示器和一盏台灯，键盘旁边放着一杯茶，窗外是远处的城市。角色2始终坐在工位前的转椅里面对电脑工作，角色1离开后在清晨又回来。环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
constraints: 全片两个生成片段：第一段是下班前的深夜，第二段是第二天清晨，老板在第二段推门回来时用一句话点明已经隔了一天，两段之间是硬切。机位固定。角色2（小程）全程坐在工位前的转椅里面对电脑，没有离开；电脑显示器全程亮着，屏幕上是中文界面；那杯茶放在键盘旁边，他不去拿。角色1（老板）第一段站着说话，说完关门离开，第二段推门回来站在工位旁。角色1语气急躁、催得紧，角色2语气慢而稳。全程中文对话。画面中只有这两名角色。
source_script:
角色1：小程，下班前新版本一定要上线！
角色2：好的，没问题！
角色1离场：关门出去。
角色2动作：他还在工位上面对电脑敲着键盘，听见门响抬起头。
角色1入场：开门进来
角色1：新版本昨天怎么还没上线？
角色2：我还没下班呢
角色2动作：说完他转回屏幕，继续敲键盘。

events.text: 小程，下班前新版本一定要上线！
他还在工位上面对电脑敲着键盘，听见门响抬起头。
新版本昨天怎么还没上线？
说完他转回屏幕，继续敲键盘。

execution.look: A semi-realistic illustration style with fine brushwork and soft light, in the quiet mood of an urban night and early morning.
execution.setting: An office corner: a desk stands by the window with one glowing computer monitor and a desk lamp on it, a mug of tea beside the keyboard, and the city visible far outside the window. Character 2 works at the desk in the swivel chair facing the computer the whole time, while Character 1 leaves and comes back the next morning. Every legible text in the environment, including the screen, is in Chinese.
execution.visible_state: A desk by the window with one glowing computer monitor and a desk lamp, a mug of tea beside the keyboard, and the city far outside the window. Character 2 sits in the swivel chair facing the monitor with both hands on the keyboard, his face lit by the screen glow, and Character 1 stands on the left of frame facing right.

voices.character_1: young male, clean low-mid register, flat and even, deadpan, cold, short phrasing
voices.character_2: young male, clear warm mid register, chest-supported, slow and relaxed pace

directions.event_003: Character 1 pushes the door shut and walks out of frame, and the room is left lit by the desk lamp and the monitor glow while Character 2 stays at the desk.
directions.event_004: Character 2 keeps typing on the keyboard facing the glowing monitor in the lamplight, then pauses and lifts his head toward the door as the handle turns.
directions.event_005: Character 1 opens the door and steps into the room, and bright early-morning daylight floods the space through the window behind Character 2.
directions.event_008: Character 2 turns back to the monitor and keeps typing on the keyboard, still seated in the swivel chair.
